title: Local Validation Report Template
purpose: Document intended use, local cohort, exact system version, discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific performance, subgroup findings, workflow, clinical utility, uncertainty, and the resulting local decision.
notes: Synthetic local-validation example aligned with Chapter 11 and Release V1.0; replace all assumptions with local evidence.

records.Response / evidence: Does the exact model and workflow support a controlled pilot for adult medical discharges?
Adult medical discharges from January to December 2025; exclusions documented for incomplete follow-up.
AUROC 0.78 (95% interval 0.75–0.81); threshold-specific sensitivity and positive predictive value reported separately.
Calibration-in-the-large +0.03; slope 0.88; overprediction concentrated in the highest-risk group.
Lower sensitivity among patients with incomplete prior-utilization history; access and notes differences require mitigation.
Single-site retrospective cohort, changing discharge workflow, and limited follow-up for patients receiving care elsewhere.
Proceed to a time-limited pilot with recalibration, subgroup monitoring, case-management capacity limits, and a prespecified stop rule.

records.Response: Proceed to a controlled pilot with conditions.
Local recalibration is feasible; response capacity remains within the pilot limit; subgroup monitoring is available.
Transportability after workflow change and incomplete cross-provider follow-up.
